title: What is the life expectancy of a DeLonghi coffee machine?
desc: A DeLonghi coffee machine typically lasts between 3 to 5 years with regular use and proper care. Regular cleaning, descaling, and adherence to the maintenance instructions in the user manual can help extend its lifespan.

title: How do I contact DeLonghi customer service center?

title: Do DeLonghi coffee machines need servicing?
desc: To ensure your delonghi coffee machines stay in excellent condition, we recommend having them serviced once a year. Additionally, similar to our repair services, we can service and maintain coffee machines either in our service centre or at your location.

title: What happens if you Don't descale DeLonghi?
desc: If the machine is not descaled regularly, the water outlets can start to narrow. As a result, your coffee may be dispensed more slowly, or the water might not flow through the outlets properly. This could lead to the coffee dripping even after the preparation has finished. These issues are often the first signs of a coffee machine needing attention.

title: What can I use instead of DeLonghi descaler?
desc: It’s time to clean your coffee maker, but you're out of descaling tablets. If you need your coffee now, an easy home remedy is to use white vinegar and water to clean your coffee maker.

title: What is the common problem of coffee machines?
desc: Whether you're using a drip coffee machine or a single-serve coffee maker, slow or no water flow is a common issue that many home coffee machines face. This problem can have several causes. One possible reason is that the water tank may not be properly positioned.

title: What happens if a coffee machine is not kept clean?
desc: If you leave your coffee machine uncleaned, the residue can lead to several undesirable effects on your coffee. Firstly, your coffee may develop a bitter taste. Additionally, both your coffee and the machine can produce an unpleasant smell. Moreover, coffee residue can cause clogging and blockages, which may ultimately render the machine unusable.

title: What chemical is in DeLonghi descaler?
desc: This eco-friendly descaler utilises natural lactic acid from plants, ensuring it won't harm the environment.

title: Do coffee machines need maintenance?
desc: To ensure a coffee machine performs optimally, it must be maintained regularly every six months. This maintenance includes descaling the machine, cleaning the brew groups and steam assemblies, and replacing the anti-suction valves.

title: What happens if a coffee machine is not cleaned regularly?
desc: Machines that are not cleaned regularly will not only produce a poor-tasting cup of coffee, but they also risk damage. Most machines feature a microporous steel filter, and over time, a build-up of coffee tannins can block this filter. This blockage can cause the machine to jam and ultimately break down.

title: Is coffee bad for a cough with phlegm?
desc: When you're feeling unwell, you might instinctively grab your usual cup of coffee. However, it's important to note that while coffee can provide relief for some cold symptoms, it may actually worsen your cough because it can lead to dehydration. So, while coffee might help with certain cold effects, its dehydrating properties could exacerbate your coughing.

title: Which coffee is good for health?
desc: Overall, lighter roasts generally have less caffeine and more antioxidants than darker roasts. The type of bean can affect the caffeine content, but both Arabica and Robusta beans can give you the full health benefits of coffee.

title: What are the benefits of drinking coffee?
desc:
Here are some health benefits that coffee can offer:
  • Improve overall health.
  • Protect against Type 2 diabetes.
  • Control Parkinson's disease symptoms.
  • Slow the progress of dementia.
  • Safeguard the liver.
  • Promote heart health.
  • Reduce melanoma risk.
  • Lower mortality risk.

title: Which is better: tea or coffee?
desc: Both tea and coffee are safe to drink and offer potential health benefits. While tea may provide more advantages than coffee, it's important to be mindful of your caffeine intake with either beverage. Ultimately, your choice may come down to personal preference and cultural influences.
